# Evals (server)

<!-- Generated by `npm run docs` from the code. Edit the code comments, not this file. -->

Evaluation suites: cases, runs, the LLM judge, schedules and the alerts a run raises.

## Files

- `alert-routes.ts`: Monitoring alerts from evaluation runs: list, acknowledge, raise an issue.
- `eval-records.ts`: Turns evaluation suite and case rows into API records.
- `eval-routes.ts`: Evaluation suites: schedules, suites, cases, runs and issues from failed cases.
- `eval-runner.ts`: Runs an evaluation suite: sends each case to the model, scores it (rules or an LLM judge), records the run and checks it for alerts.
